## 0f0d405d5bb8

**Classification:** Reproduced distribution shortcut/domain gap; audit only, no
source changed.

The plausible rival is: infer the outer rectangular color-1 frame and draw the
alternating rays to that outer frame, **ignoring any internal color-1 wall as a
stop condition**. This rival fits all 5/5 canonical pairs, and the current
sampler always creates only a hollow outer frame.

Counterexample input (palette 4/6, seed 9, internal wall at row 4 column 6):

```text
046000000000
011111111110
010000000010
010000000010
010000109010
010000000010
010000000010
011111111110
000000000000
```

The selected authority uses the seed's non-1 connected chamber and stops the
left ray at the internal wall. The rival continues past it, producing four
extra colored cells. The input passes the target's current `self_check` with no
findings, while a bounded census of 120 generated inputs (40 seeds in each of
easy/medium/hard) found **0/120** with an interior color-1 wall.

Hashes: generator
`182e05b3a7210cc2ec94b72c837c57a33921bef7bea0e5ab4409bd346ad42cf4`;
executed/catalog rule `2ab37d675dd1` (match). Exact input, selected Racket
output, rival output, differing cells, validator result, sampler census, command,
and working directory are retained in
`checks/audit/0f0d405d5bb8/finding.json`; the supported apply receipt is
`checks/audit/0f0d405d5bb8/racket.json`.

**Suggested future repair:** add internal blocking walls/chamber variants and an
executable rival witness; strengthen `self_check` to distinguish the intended
domain from merely “some frame cells and a seed.”
